details: Blockchain.com, a prominent cryptocurrency exchange, has confidentially submitted an application for an initial public offering (IPO) in the United States. This move indicates a growing trend of crypto firms seeking to enter public markets as the digital asset landscape shows signs of recovery and maturation. Confidential filings allow companies to prepare for an IPO away from immediate public scrutiny.
title: Crypto Exchange Blockchain.com Confidentially Files for US IPO

details: Variational, a protocol specializing in on-chain derivatives trading, has successfully raised approximately $50 million in Series A funding. The round was led by Dragonfly, with participation from notable investors like Bain Capital Crypto and Coinbase Ventures. This funding coincides with the launch of the protocol's first Real-World Asset (RWA) markets, designed to route liquidity directly from traditional finance into the crypto ecosystem.
title: Variational Secures $50M to Bridge Traditional and Crypto Markets

details: Bitcoin has shown stabilization around the $77,000 mark, experiencing broadly flat price action over the past 24-48 hours. This occurs despite a global bond market sell-off. While spot demand has softened with a period of negative spot Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD), derivatives indicate a defensive posture. Some analysts suggest a "bearish" sentiment for the current market regime, while others see consolidation and a rotation in the holder base.
title: Bitcoin Stabilizes Near $77,000 Amid Mixed Market Signals

details: Ripple, the blockchain company behind XRP, achieved a significant milestone by being ranked 16th on CNBC's prestigious list of top 50 disruptor companies for 2026, surpassing many established names. Concurrently, Ripple Prime announced a strategic partnership with EDX Markets and EDX International, aiming to provide institutional clients with integrated access to cryptocurrency spot and perpetual futures liquidity. Plans for future integration of Ripple's stablecoin, RLUSD, are also in motion.
title: Ripple Ranks High on CNBC Disruptor List, Forms EDX Markets Partnership

details: Solana's highly anticipated "Alpenglow" upgrade, a major overhaul of its consensus mechanism, has entered its community test cluster. This upgrade is projected to dramatically reduce transaction finality from 12.8 seconds to an impressive 150 milliseconds. Solana's co-founder, Anatoly Yakovenko, hinted at a mainnet launch possibly next quarter if testing progresses smoothly. The SOL token has seen a 15% increase in May, recovering to around $85, despite a 38% year-to-date decline.
title: Solana's Alpenglow Upgrade Moves Closer to Mainnet for Faster Transactions

details: The U.S. Federal Reserve has initiated a 60-day public comment period for a proposal concerning "skinny" payment accounts. These limited-purpose accounts aim to provide non-bank financial institutions, including digital asset firms, with improved access to the Fed's payment rails. The proposal is designed to facilitate faster and more cost-effective payment clearing and settlement, though these accounts would not offer full master-account privileges like intraday credit.
title: Federal Reserve Proposes "Skinny" Payment Accounts for Crypto Firms

details: The decentralized futures trading platform Hyperliquid (HYPE) recently surged to a new all-time high, rallying over 53% to reach approximately $58-$59. This significant price appreciation is attributed to robust inflows into Hyperliquid ETFs, which were launched in May by 21Shares and Bitwise. Bloomberg ETF Analyst James Seyffart highlighted that traditional finance investors are increasingly drawn to Hyperliquid due to its strong revenue model and its significant share of on-chain transaction fees.
title: Hyperliquid (HYPE) Hits All-Time High Driven by Institutional ETF Inflows

details: The overall cryptocurrency market is currently experiencing a positive momentum, with a significant majority of tracked tokens showing gains. On May 21, 327 out of 390 monitored cryptocurrencies were on the rise. Among the top performers were FIDAUSDT, Jito, and Nillion, which saw surges of 57.10%, 28.62%, and 28.06% respectively. This broad-based rally suggests a bullish market sentiment and opportunities for traders.
title: Crypto Market Shows Broad Upward Trend with Numerous Tokens Rising
